Gay USA, Vol. XV, Episode No. 15, Time Warner New York City [Air date: 4/17/1997]
1. Lesbian and Gay News: Andy Humm and Ann Northrop discuss recent general events that relate to the LGBT community.
2. Interview: Kate Kendell, Director of the National Center for Lesbian Rights, discusses her organization's work and history in honor of its 20th anniversary.
4. Footage of Troy Alexander at [SqueezeBox at Don Hills] for "Rock 'n' Roll Fag Night".

5. AIDS News. Includes "Lambda Update": Beatrice Dohrn, Legal Director of the Lambda Legal Defense and Education Fund, introduces Catherine Hanssens, Lambda AIDS Project Director, speaking on telemarketers using lists of people receiving AIDS treatment.
